card.name: Just before TEN in skin reactions
card.fires_on: The last piece of SJS, or the opening bracket, when the abbreviation TEN (toxic epidermal necrolysis) is expected next. Also fires before a capital T in command flags like -T.

modes.description: The opening parenthesis after 'toxic epidermal necrolysis' where the abbreviation TEN follows.

modes.label: Flag before T
modes.description: A hyphen before a capital T in a command-line option.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a capital T as the next character, as in TEN, and away from lowercase t.
card.plain: It spots the spot in a skin-reaction warning where the letters TEN are about to come next.
